name: Lentil and Sausage Soup
description: Brown lentils simmered with Italian sausage, vegetables, and kale, finished with lemon and parmesan.
recipeIngredient: 2/3 lb Italian sausage (casings removed; chicken or turkey to keep it lighter)

recipeInstructions.text: Heat olive oil in a dutch oven over medium-high. Add Italian sausage and cook, breaking it up, until browned, 6-8 minutes. Move it to a plate with a slotted spoon, leaving the fat behind.
Lower the heat to medium. Add a diced yellow onion, carrots, and celery with a pinch of salt. Cook until soft, 8 minutes.
Stir in garlic, tomato paste, dried thyme, and red pepper flakes. Cook until the paste darkens, 2 minutes.
Add brown lentils, diced tomatoes, chicken broth, bay leaves, and the sausage. Bring to a boil, then simmer partly covered until the lentils are tender, 25-30 minutes.
Remove the bay leaves. Stir in lacinato kale and simmer until wilted, 5 minutes.
Stir in the juice of half a lemon and season with salt and black pepper. Serve topped with chopped parsley, grated parmesan, and a drizzle of olive oil.
The soup thickens as it sits; thin leftovers with broth or water. Freezes well for up to 3 months, best frozen before adding the kale.
